about.title: About us
about.heading: About RUTFinder
about.lead: We bring together in one place the information on ready-to-use therapeutic foods (RUTF) made around the world, so that choosing one is faster and better informed.
about.whyP1: RUTFs are the standard treatment for severe acute malnutrition in children. But information about them is scattered across reports, scientific papers, manufacturer catalogues and spreadsheets.
about.whyP2: Comparing products means searching many places and reconciling data that each source presents in its own way. RUTFinder does that work once, for everyone.
about.s1Text: Reports, peer-reviewed papers, grey literature and manufacturer data.
about.s2Text: Every product has the same sheet: composition, ingredients, production, cost and evidence.
about.s3Text: If a figure isn't known, the sheet says “No data”. Nothing is estimated or filled in.
about.ctaTitle: Make or know of a RUTF?

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data RUTFinder collects, what it is used for, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro: RUTFinder collects only the data needed for the tool to work. Here is what we collect, why, and what you can do about it.

p: The data controller is the owner of RUTFinder, whose details appear above. You can write to us by email or through the contact form.
Contact form: your name, email and message, so we can read it and reply by email.

Access request: your name, email, organisation, password (stored encrypted: no one on the team can see it) and, if you came from the search box, what you searched for. We use them to review your request and, if approved, to manage your account.
Account use: your favourites, the change suggestions you send us, the comparisons you make and the date of your last login. We use them to make the tool work and to improve the directory.

We process contact form data with your consent, which you give by sending it. Account data, because it is needed to provide the service you request. Security measures, such as limiting login attempts, rely on our legitimate interest in protecting the website.

Messages, for as long as needed to deal with them. Account data, while the account is active or until you ask us to delete it. If we turn down an access request, you can ask us to delete its data at any time.

We do not sell or hand over your data. The website and its database are hosted by Render (Render Services, Inc.), which acts as data processor. Render is based in the United States, so there may be international data transfers, covered by the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

We only use technical cookies that the website needs to work: one keeps you logged in (7 days) and another remembers the language you choose (1 year). In the members’ area, your browser also remembers whether you prefer to see products as a grid or a list. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies, so we do not need to ask for your consent.
The connection is encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are stored encrypted and only the team can access the admin panel.

You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to or restrict its processing, or take it to another service. Write to us by email or through the contact form. If you feel we have not handled your request properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) or to the data protection authority where you live.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.description: Details of the owner of RUTFinder, terms of use of the website and where the directory’s information comes from.
legal.intro: In accordance with Spanish Law 34/2002 on information society services and electronic commerce (LSSI), these are the details of the owner of this website and its terms of use.

p: RUTFinder is an information directory of ready-to-use therapeutic foods (RUTF) for NGOs, nutrition teams and health professionals.

The data on each product comes from public sources (reports, scientific articles, grey literature and manufacturer data) and is linked on each product page. We take care to keep it accurate, but it does not replace the manufacturer’s official information or professional judgement. If you spot an error, let us know and we will review it.
The design, texts, pictograms and code of RUTFinder belong to its owner. Product names and trademarks belong to their manufacturers.
Product pages link to third-party sources. We are not responsible for their content or availability.
This website is governed by Spanish law.

standards.howText: Each product page compares the manufacturer’s published data with these ranges and marks every value as within range, out of range or no data. Values per 100 g are converted to % of energy or mg per 100 kcal when the standard is written that way.
standards.notCert: This is guidance, not certification. Before buying, always ask for the certificate of analysis of each batch and check UNICEF approval at the source.
standards.other: Supplements for moderate malnutrition (RUSF, lipid-based supplements or fortified flours) are not RUTF and have their own specifications, mostly from the World Food Programme.
standards.needsEnergy: Energy is needed to calculate it
standards.disclaimer: RUTFinder compares the manufacturer’s declared data with the Codex and UNICEF standards. This is guidance, not certification.
standards.why: Where do these ranges come from?
standards.empty: There is no data yet to compare this product with the standards.
